response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT feecoin, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_reb, AVG((rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_gap FROM fees GROUP BY feecoin), b AS (SELECT AVG(avg_reb) AS bench FROM g), q AS (SELECT g.feecoin, g.avg_reb, g.avg_gap, b.bench FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.avg_reb > b.bench) SELECT AVG(avg_reb) AS mean_avg_rebate, AVG(avg_gap) AS mean_avg_relative_gap, AVG(avg_reb - bench) AS mean_excess_over_benchmark FROM q
